title: Saved interfaces across accepted workflow revisions
summary: Meaningful compatible source change: the same installed saved UI and common view both render the actual changed accepted input default without inheriting old run/review authority. Original source/default restores through exact CAS. No generation/compiler/execution/decision.

manualSteps.label: Meaningful compatible change
manualSteps.instruction: Use the isolated fixture after a conditional accepted-source update changes the Brief default from Synthetic review requirements to Updated requirements for the current accepted process, preserving required bindings. Open the saved working-interface link for that current digest without attaching a run. Confirm Brief (required) shows the updated value and no old Approve action appears.

manualSteps.label: Common agreement
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use common working view. Confirm Brief (required) shows the same updated default and no historical review is present. Do not start or approve anything.

manualSteps.label: Restore and reuse
manualSteps.instruction: Restore the exact original accepted source through its conditional update. Open the same saved interface in preparation mode at the restored digest without a run. Confirm the original default returns and the old review is not automatically attached.
